cache.failure: Preserve the last Headlines snapshot when it is still truthful; otherwise show the candidate-specific empty or setup state.

validation: Selections and limits are within supported bounds

presentation.compact: Top selected headline
presentation.standard: Existing Headlines owns source, title, and published time
presentation.full: Existing Headlines may add topic filters and more selected sources
presentation.interaction: Open the item through the existing Headlines widget
presentation.empty: Use the existing Headlines setup and empty state
presentation.loading: Show a content-tight loading state for configured RSS feeds.
presentation.stale: Keep feed titles and article metadata visible with its last-updated time while refreshing.
presentation.error: Keep the last Headlines snapshot when useful and offer one bounded retry or setup action.

decision.rationale: This value belongs inside the existing RSS identity instead of creating a duplicate widget
